whatThisFileIs: An R1 authorship claim for the AFC-299 regression guard that locks probe()'s refused-switch marker into --self-test (the F1 deliverable) and the F2 hardening of assert_raises. Coder is the author. This claim asserts authorship and the paths; R2 is a review by a named non-author reviewer (the CTO reviews Coder compliance-path commits) and is recorded when the verdict lands.
basis: AFC-299 is the F1/F2 follow-up to the independent security review of AFC-257 (review issue AFC-288, verdict SHIP, verified by execution). The F4 fix (commit 6295956) makes test_support.probe() return 'ROLE_SWITCH_REFUSED <sqlstate> | <message>' when the SET LOCAL ROLE is refused, instead of returning the refusal as the statement's sqlstate. The fix is correct but nothing in the suite could observe it: the runner's session is postgres with rolsuper=true, so every SET LOCAL ROLE in all 14 suites is accepted and the refusal branch is never taken. A revert of probe() left node scripts/run-db-tests.mjs green. F1 (this commit) adds a permanent regression assertion to the --self-test path that becomes a non-superuser LOGIN not a member of retention_worker and asserts the marker is present and that assert_raises raises. F2 hardens assert_raises to treat v_got LIKE 'ROLE_SWITCH_REFUSED %' as a fixture failure regardless of the expected string, so the guarantee is type-enforced rather than convention-enforced.
verificationRecorded: node scripts/run-db-tests.mjs -> 15 suites / 543 assertions / 0 failing. node scripts/run-db-tests.mjs --self-test -> exit 0, including the new 'Self-test: the refused-switch marker (AFC-299)' section (6 assertions). Revert experiment (scratch copy, probe() restored to the pre-AFC-257 shape from 6295956^): --self-test -> exit 1, red, with the measured evidence 'got: 42501 | permission denied to set role "retention_worker"' (bare SQLSTATE, no marker) and five SELF-TEST FAIL lines. The 14 suites' behaviour is unchanged: the marker never appears in them because the runner session is a superuser, so the F2 branch is never taken.

r2Review.note: The CTO reviews Coder compliance-path commits. This entry records the intended reviewer; the verdict is recorded as a reviews[] entry in this claim file (or a Reviewed-by: trailer) once the review lands. tests/db/** is on REVIEW_REQUIRED_PATHS, so R2 requires a non-author reviewer before the commit is clear.
